favourite.heading: Why Louisville can pull away
bullets: Playing at Louisville is worth 4.1 points — the league-wide home-field number, because a per-venue table was tested and could not be told apart from the home team’s own quality (+4.1 pts).

Louisville is the better football team by 3.7 points on opponent-adjusted results — but about 74% of that rating is still last season carried forward, and in a portal era last season is a different team (+3.7 pts).
Stylistically the matchup favours Louisville by 0.6 points: early-down offence vs early-down defence (+0.6 pts).

underdog.heading: Why Wake Forest can keep it close
bullets: The outcome range is 15.3 points wide at one sigma — p10 -14.6 to p90 +29.4 for Louisville, so a projection of +8.4 still produces results a long way either side of it.
It is early enough that both ratings still lean on preseason belief — it widens the outcome range by about 4%.
College ratings are built on twelve-game seasons against wildly uneven schedules; even a clean rating gap carries more estimation error than the number implies.
